name: skdmhesapla-mcp-server
description: Enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool server for EU CBAM compliance, CN scope checking, embedded emissions calculation, and maritime regulatory validation under Regulation (EU) 2023/956 and (EU) 2025/2547.

tools.name: query_skdm_compliance
tools.description: Perform structured semantic query on SKDMHesapla regulatory knowledge base, EU CBAM annexes, and Turkish industrial benchmarks.

query.description: Natural language or technical compliance query

tools.name: check_scope_cn
tools.description: Determines whether an 8-digit Combined Nomenclature (CN) / GTİP code falls under EU CBAM Annex I scope.

tools.name: calculate_cbam_emissions
tools.description: Calculates direct and indirect specific embedded emissions under Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547.

tools.name: check_maritime_scope
tools.description: Evaluates ship regulatory obligations across EU MRV, EU ETS Maritime, and FuelEU Maritime.
